newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks rise 6.08pct reacting to recent fall.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks rise 6.08pct reacting to recent fall.

text.p: Greek stocks were trading 6.08 percent higher 30 minutes before the closing and market watchers said it was a strong reaction to the bourse's recent sharp fall.

"I think the market is reacting to the bourse' recent dramatic fall. I would like to see milder fluctuations and I expect a stabilisation this week," said Pandelis Mytilinios, an analyst at Sarros Securities.
The new resistance level would be 1,300 points, he said.
Fund managers said today's rise was too sharp after its recent abrupt drop. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
